testState.note: Passing suite is accepted as observed evidence but does not override falsified release claims.

blockers.title: Same-owner concurrent durable claimants can both receive CLAIMED with the same fence generation
blockers.finding: The PostgreSQL claim path increments fence_generation on lease-expiry takeover but not on every successful claim grant. Two distinct processes sharing the same ownerToken can each hold an empty in-process activeFences map and both receive CLAIMED for the same idempotency key/command with the same durable fence generation while the lease remains active.
blockers.impact: Two domain executions can run concurrently while each believes it owns the same command effect. This can duplicate consequential side effects before one eventual durable commit loses.
blockers.requiredFix: Issue a fresh database-backed unique fencing generation or claim identity on every successful CLAIMED grant, and add a live PostgreSQL adversarial test with two independent claimants sharing one owner token. The fix must prove only one claimant can execute for a given command effect at a time.

blockers.title: Transfer-policy ratification trusts caller-shaped authorization instead of the authority source of truth
blockers.finding: GovernedTransferPolicyRegistry.ratify validates a supplied TransferPolicyAuthorization object for internal consistency but does not verify the referenced grant through the canonical authority store/evaluator. A fabricated internally-consistent authorization object can therefore satisfy ratification checks.
blockers.impact: The transfer-policy boundary overstates its INV-001 enforcement claim and repeats the unverified-attestation class previously removed from purchase commitment.
blockers.requiredFix: Replace bare authorization trust with a verifier/evaluator backed by the authority source of truth, and add adversarial tests showing fabricated, revoked, expired, wrong-scope and mismatched grants cannot ratify policy.

invariantInterpretation: Existing PARTIAL_GREEN invariant mappings remain historical bounded proofs only. RC3 falsifies the sufficiency of the current INV-027/INV-028 durability boundary for release and falsifies the transfer package's claimed INV-001 authority verification. No invariant is promoted to full GREEN.
decision: SW0 must not be frozen as SW0_KERNEL_BASELINE_v1.0. Preserve this NO-GO as release evidence, remediate RC3-B01 and RC3-B02 with executable adversarial proofs, then run a fresh independent RC3 re-review before any SW0 baseline freeze or SW1 start.
